question: How are the sixty-four yoginīs related to the goddess contemplated by the practitioner?
premises: The goddess is supported by sixty-four.
inference: The goddess supported by sixty-four is the one by whom the yoginīs are contemplated.
uncertainties: The referent of yena could be the practitioner or the goddess depending on reading.
plain_english: The goddess supported by the sixty-four, by whom the yoginīs are contemplated.
